name: Kara no Shoujo - The Second Episode
source:
In the years before Japan went to war and the world went to hell, amidst the deep snows of the mountainous north, there was a small hamlet known as Hitogata where by ancient custom the residents were prone to worship clay dolls. One night, during their festival, a woman was murdered, and the people came to speak of this as their god’s curse—divine retribution for trying to take the power of their god into their own hands.

[b]December 1957.[/b]

It’s been nearly two years since the events of [url=/v810]Kara no Shoujo[/url].

Reiji Tokisaka’s little sister Yukari saves a man from suicide—but that man is a victim of the curse’s return…

Reiji steps in to sever a cycle of obsession that has persisted since before the war—[i]but still struggles with his own obsession.[/i]

Meanwhile, a cult rises from the ashes after six years of silence—but what are they planning?

Curses may be the devices of the gods, but it’s always human hands that carry their knives.

[Based on [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/5857]Shiravune's description of The Shell Part II: Purgatorio[/url]]
translation:
在日本走向战争、世界坠入地狱之前的岁月里，北方山地的深雪之中有一个名叫人形的小村落。依照古老习俗，村民常常祭拜陶偶。某个祭典之夜，一名女子遭到杀害，人们开始把这起事件称作神明的诅咒——那是试图将神力掌握在人类手中的报应。

[b]1957年12月。[/b]

距离[url=/v810]《壳之少女》[/url]中的事件已经过去将近两年。

时坂玲人的妹妹紫救下了一名试图自杀的男子——而他正是诅咒再度降临的受害者…

玲人决意斩断自战前延续至今的执念循环——[i]但他自己仍在与心中的执念挣扎。[/i]

与此同时，一个沉寂六年的邪教从灰烬中重新崛起——他们究竟在策划什么？

诅咒或许是神明的手段，但握住刀的永远是人类的手。

[基于[url=https://shiravune.com/archives/5857]Shiravune对《壳之少女 第二部：炼狱》的简介[/url]]
